about: The conventions every first-party Rust Pantheon GUI app follows. docs/APP-CONVENTIONS.md explains them; mseries-pantheon-kit/tests/conventions.rs checks them. An entry under `exempt` is a known gap or a deliberate exception: it names the rule and says why. Fix the gap and delete the entry, never the reverse.

rules.id: Every desktop entry is <namespace><Name>.desktop; its Icon and StartupWMClass equal that id, an <id>.svg ships next to it, and the id is the application id the code registers.
rules.colors: No hex colour literals in the app's Rust or CSS; use theme/Granite named colours or the tokens in msdk/data/tokens.json.
rules.color_scheme: The app follows the Granite colour scheme (mseries_pantheon_kit::appearance::follow_color_scheme).
rules.window_size: The main window uses appearance::size_window with the shared default and minimum sizes.
rules.about: The app has an About dialog.
rules.toasts: The app reports results with Granite/Adw toasts, not silent state changes.
rules.gettext: User-visible strings go through an app-owned gettext domain.

exempt.colors: terminal and web view palettes, provider accents (documented in the audit)
exempt.color_scheme: has its own light/dark/system Appearance setting
follows the desktop colour scheme through its own dconf watcher

exempt.gettext: gap: strings.rs is prepared but no domain is bound yet
